honesty: These are external NVIDIA assets, downloaded from the SimReady dataset on Hugging Face — not RobotForge models.
They are bench dressing in the kit scene only: they are not kit parts, not catalog robots, and nothing about them is checked by the gate.
The source packages' physics and material data do not survive the trip to glTF; what you see is shape and surface colour only.
Each model was decimated and its textures resized/re-encoded to fit a web size budget (per-prop numbers below); silhouettes and proportions are the source's, fine detail is reduced.
license_note: Each package's own LICENSE.txt and packaging.json declare CC BY 4.0 (verified per package 2026-10-31; the dataset card itself carries no license tag).
